main.description: A release of a Zena package, at the record key equal to its version. A client rejects a release whose version is not its record key.

version.description: A semantic version without build metadata, such as '1.4.2' or '2.0.0-rc.1'.

dependencies.description: No two dependencies have the same name, or the same DID and major version.

artifact.description: An artifact, held either in 'blob' or, when it is larger than the PDS accepts, in 'parts' that concatenate to it, with 'size' and 'cid' giving the whole.

kind.description: A 'source' artifact is a source archive, a CAR file whose root is a 'dev.zena-lang.package.tree'. A 'component' needs 'world' and 'wit'.

size.description: With 'parts': the sum of the parts' sizes.

cid.description: With 'parts': the raw CID of their concatenation.

world.description: The WIT world a component targets, such as 'wasi:http/proxy@0.3.0'.

version.description: The lowest version the release works with.

name.description: The local name the release's own imports use for the package, under the rules for a profile's name.
